title: Supplier Development Program Manager
description:
Job Summary A Day in Your Life at MKS: The Supply Chain Development Manager is responsible for leading supplier and supply chain development activities within the assigned region. This role focuses on identifying, assessing, qualifying, and developing suppliers to support current and future business requirements. The position drives availability and capability of new and existing suppliers across quality, delivery, capacity, technology, operational excellence, and supply continuity to ensure alignment with MKS strategic objectives. The Supply Chain Development Manager serves as the primary interface between suppliers and MKS cross-functional stakeholders for strategic supply chain programs within the region. The role collaborates closely with Category Management, Business Units stakeholders (Engineering and Management), Procurement, and Supplier Quality teams to ensure supplier readiness, risk mitigation, and successful program execution. You Will Make an Impact By: Supplier Capability Development Assess supply chain potentials and capability in terms of manufacturing capabilities, capacity, technical competencies, operational maturity, and quality management systems. Identify supplier gaps, constraints, and development opportunities related to quality, delivery, cost, technology, and capacity. Develop and execute supplier improvement plans to enhance operational performance and supply chain reliability. Develop supplier capability roadmaps aligned with future business and technology requirements. Facilitate supplier process optimization, automation, and manufacturing technology initiatives. Monitor supplier readiness to support production ramp-ups, strategic customer programs, and business growth. Supplier Assessment & Audits Perform supplier capability assessments and operational evaluations. Conduct on-site audits focused on manufacturing, quality, capacity, and business processes. Evaluate suppliers against company requirements and industry standards. Support supplier qualification and approval activities. Supply Chain Risk Management Identify and assess risks associated with supplier capacity, quality performance, delivery performance, financial stability, and business continuity. Develop mitigation plans to address supply chain vulnerabilities and potential disruptions. Support dual-source strategies, supplier diversification initiatives, and contingency planning activities. Lead risk management activities for strategic customer programs and critical product categories. Drive supplier recovery plans when performance or supply continuity is at risk. Required Skills A bachelor s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, or related technical discipline. A minimum of 8-10 years of related experience working in a complex supply chain and/or manufacturing environment Strong written and verbal communication skills Previous Supplier Development/Supplier Quality experience Practical understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes including machining, fabrication, welding, electro-mechanical assembly. Practical experience in evaluating supplier capabilities, operational performance, and manufacturing readiness. The ability to travel up to 30% of the time Preferred Skills Practical Experience and Continuous Improvement methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma a plus Previous experience in conducting/assisting sourcing events is a plus Previous experience working with PCBA and electro-mechanical assembly process is a plus Physical Demands and Working Conditions: Travel may be required (domestic & some international) up to 30%

description:
Role - Techical Project Manager (Hybrid)

 ICRA Analytics Ltd a wholly owned subsidiary of ICRA Ltd, a leading credit rating agency in India and an affiliate 
 of Moodys Investors Service, is looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager. 
 THE COMPANY 
 ICRA Analytics have presence across Mumbai, NCR, Kolkata and Chennai and an array of offerings for domestic 
 and global clients. 
 1. We offer knowledge process outsourcing services comprising automated data management and 
 analytical support with high accuracy and quick turnaround to support the business needs of our 
 clients. 
 2. We provide risk assessment services, including grading services for MSMEs and ESCOs as well as 
 vendor and counter-party assessment tools and services. 
 3. We implement risk management solutions in credit risk, including internal rating models and 
 expected credit loss for banks, NBFCs and other market participants. 
 4. We are a trusted provider of data, research and analytics on mutual fund, fixed income and other 
 asset classes to fund managers, investors, lenders and intermediaries. 
 5. We offer consulting services, tools and solutions on early warning signals, enterprise risk 
 management, risk modelling, portfolio analytics, fund ranking and implementation of regulatory 
 standards to enable our clients to measure, manage and mitigate risks based on traditional as well as 
 alternate data and insights derived from our proprietary models. 
 We make extensive use of technology and leverage our domain expertise through process automation, building 
 intelligent software, developing cloud-hosted solutions, deploying digital platforms for external and internal 
 customers, etc. We are an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2013 certified company, with strong focus on infosec 
 and business continuity to ensure data security, availability, and integrity on 24*7 basis. 
 We are a strong engaged team with diverse qualifications and skills across GAAP, IFRS, financial statement 
 analysis and interpretation, credit risk modelling, financial asset and business valuation, fund research, ESG, 
 structured finance, Python, R, .Net, SQL, Oracle, GIS, etc. We have executed more than 10,000 assignments over 
 the last 20 years and add value to our clients by integrating our deep domain expertise with robust technology 
 framework. Our goal is to provide offerings that are contemporary, and we continue to upgrade and supplement 
 our repertoire with a demonstrated focus on continuous learning. 
 Earning accolades for our services, we were recently awarded as the Top Exporter 2020-21 (ITES Less than 
 1000 million in FY21) and company with Highest Percentage of Women Employees 2020-21 (IT/ITES Less 
 than 1000 million in FY21) by STPI Export Awards, West Bengal. 
 Job Title: Technical Project Manager 
 Location: Kolkata / Bangalore 
 Qualifications: B.Tech (CS/IT), MCA, M.Tech- IT. 
 Experience: 9-12 Years 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead end-to-end delivery for one or more product/engineering squads (8-12 developers), owning 
 scope, timelines, risks, and quality. 
 Run Scrum/Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, reviews, retrospectives); manage backlog 
 health, velocity, and predictable releases. 
 Stay hands-on: review code/design, unblock engineers, and contribute directly when needed in at least 
 one of .NET, Java, or Python. 
 Partner with product, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into actionable, 
 well-estimated engineering plans. 
 
 
 
 ¢ Champion engineering quality - unit testing, code coverage, CI/CD discipline, and secure coding 
 practices (OWASP, secure SDLC). 
 ¢ Track and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and business 
 leadership. 
 ¢ Coach and mentor developers; drive continuous improvement in team throughput and quality. 
 ¢ Juggle multiple parallel workstreams and shifting priorities without dropping delivery commitments. 
 ¢ Plan projects keeping key aspects like capacity data, velocity trends, dependency and risk analysis in 
 mind. 
 ¢ Act as the guardian of delivery quality and the customer experience, and able to articulate 
 consequences of compromising on quality, technical-debt and reputation. 
 ¢ Negotiate scope, timeline, and resource trade-offs with stakeholders proposing viable alternatives 
 (phased delivery, MVP-first, re-prioritization). 
 ¢ Set and manage realistic expectations early, surfacing any shortcomings on capacity, clarity and final 
 delivery. 
 ¢ Protect organizational investment from scope creep, unplanned work and reactive churn, ensuring 
 changes flow through proper impact assessment and re-planning rather than being absorbed silently. 
 Required Skills/Abilities: 
 ¢ 9-12 years in software engineering, with 3+ years leading/managing teams of 8-12 developers. 
 ¢ Hands-on proficiency in at least one core backend stack: .NET, Java, or Python. 
 ¢ Working knowledge of a modern frontend framework: Angular or React. 
 ¢ Strong command of Agile/Scrum delivery; experience as Scrum Master or Agile lead. 
 ¢ Solid understanding of unit testing practices and application security fundamentals (secure SDLC, 
 OWASP Top 10). 
 ¢ Excellent business communication - able to interface confidently with clients, executives, and cross- 
 functional stakeholders. 
 ¢ Proven ability to multitask across concurrent projects and priorities. 
 ¢ Demonstrated ability to influence and negotiate with senior business stakeholders, while preserving 
 trust and long-term relationships. 
 ¢ Sound estimation and risk-management judgment able to defend timelines with credible data and 
 not putting quality at stake. 
 Nice-to-Have: 
 ¢ Experience across more than one core stack, or full-stack exposure. 
 ¢ Cloud experience (Azure / AWS / GCP) and CI/CD tooling. 
 ¢ Certifications: PMP, CSM/PSM, or SAFe. 
 ¢ Domain experiences relevant to the team's product area. 
 ¢ Comfortable in holding the line under pressure and managing conflict maturely. 
 Understanding of Quality Processes like ISO, CMM, etc. 
 Information Security Responsibility - Maintain Confidentiality and Integrity of organization information. 
 Compensation: per Company pay-scale.

title: Sr. Project Manager (Airport- Baggage Handling System)
description:
Job Description Senior Project Manager Airport Systems / Baggage Handling Systems (BHS) Position Overview We are seeking an experienced and PMP-certified Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex Airport Systems and Baggage Handling System (BHS) projects. The role will be responsible for end-to-end project management, including planning, engineering, procurement, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, stakeholder management, and final handover. The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing large-scale airport projects involving Baggage Handling Systems, baggage screening, sortation, conveyors, EBS, HBS, PLC/SCADA, controls, airport IT/OT systems, and system integration . Key Responsibilities Project Management Lead end-to-end delivery of airport systems and BHS projects from project initiation through commissioning and handover.
 Develop and maintain the overall project execution plan, schedule, milestones, budgets, and resource plans.
 Establish project governance, reporting structures, KPIs, risk registers, and change-control processes.
 Manage project scope, cost, schedule, quality, resources, procurement, and contractual obligations.
 Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with approved scope, budget, schedule, quality, and safety requirements.
 Apply PMI/PMP project management methodologies and industry best practices.
 Airport & BHS Systems Provide project leadership for Baggage Handling Systems (BHS) including:
 Baggage conveyors and transportation systems
 Sortation systems
 Early Baggage Storage (EBS)
 Hold Baggage Screening (HBS)
 Explosive Detection Systems (EDS)
 Make-up and reclaim systems
 Baggage reconciliation and tracking
 Baggage security and screening interfaces
 PLC, SCADA, HMI and controls systems
 Baggage Information Systems (BIS)
 Airport Operational Database (AODB) and relevant airport-system interfaces
 Coordinate integration between BHS, airport IT/OT, security systems, screening equipment, airline systems, and other airport infrastructure.
 Review system architecture, interface requirements, functional specifications, design documentation, and integration plans.
 Coordinate engineering and technical teams to resolve design and implementation issues.
 Project Execution & Delivery Manage multidisciplinary teams comprising project managers, engineers, automation/control specialists, IT/OT teams, installation teams, subcontractors, and vendors.
 Coordinate with airport authorities, airlines, government agencies, consultants, system integrators, OEMs, contractors, and other stakeholders.
 Monitor construction, installation, integration, testing, and commissioning activities.
 Lead Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), system integration testing, operational trials, and final commissioning.
 Ensure project readiness for airport operational cutover and transition.
 Manage project interfaces and dependencies across civil, MEP, security, IT, OT, automation, and airport operational systems.
 Stakeholder & Commercial Management Act as the primary project interface with clients, airport operators, consultants, partners, and senior stakeholders.
 Lead regular project progress meetings and steering-committee reviews.
 Manage subcontractors, suppliers, OEMs, and system integrators.
 Support contract administration, change requests, claims, variations, and commercial negotiations.
 Identify and manage commercial and contractual risks.
 Ensure timely resolution of customer issues and project escalations.
 Risk, Quality & Compliance Maintain project risk, issue, action, and dependency registers.
 Develop and implement mitigation and contingency plans.
 Ensure compliance with applicable airport, aviation, safety, security, quality, and contractual requirements.
 Drive project quality assurance and quality-control activities.
 Ensure appropriate documentation, configuration management, testing records, and handover documentation are maintained.
 Promote a strong safety culture throughout project execution.
 Reporting & Governance Prepare executive-level project reports covering schedule, cost, risks, issues, progress, quality, resources, and commercial status.
 Track project KPIs, critical-path activities, milestones, and deliverables.
 Provide accurate forecasts for project completion, cost, resources, and risks.
 Escalate critical issues and recommend corrective actions to senior management.
 Maintain complete project documentation and lessons learned.
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics, Mechanical, Automation, or a related discipline .
 PMP certification is mandatory/preferred. 
 Typically 12+ years of overall project management experience , with significant experience in airport systems, BHS, automation, industrial systems, or complex infrastructure projects.
 Demonstrated experience managing large-scale airport systems or Baggage Handling System projects .
 Strong understanding of project lifecycle management from design through commissioning and operational handover.
 Required Technical Experience Candidates should have practical knowledge of several of the following: Baggage Handling Systems (BHS)
 Baggage sortation and conveyor systems
 HBS/HBS integration
 EBS
 EDS/baggage screening interfaces
 PLC and industrial automation
 SCADA/HMI
 Baggage tracking and reconciliation systems
 Airport IT/OT systems
 System integration and interface management
 FAT, SAT, SIT and commissioning
 Airport operational systems and interfaces
 Testing, cutover and operational readiness
 Vendor/OEM and subcontractor management
 Core Competencies Strong leadership and team-management skills
 Excellent stakeholder-management and communication skills
 Strong planning, scheduling, and execution capabilities
 Commercial and contractual awareness
 Risk and issue management
 Problem-solving and decision-making
 Change and configuration management
 Ability to manage multiple workstreams and complex interfaces
 Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills
 Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced airport/operational environment
 Preferred Experience Experience with major international or greenfield airport projects.
 Experience working with airport authorities, airport operators, airlines, consultants, and major system integrators.
 Experience with brownfield airport upgrades and live-airport environments.
 Experience managing multi-vendor BHS and airport-system integration.
 Familiarity with international airport standards and applicable aviation/security requirements.
 Experience with projects involving 24x7 operational environments and phased cutovers.
 International project experience is an advantage.
 Key Deliverables The Senior Project Manager will be accountable for: Project execution strategy and project management plan
 Master project schedule and milestone management

 Operational readiness and airport cutover

 Successful delivery within agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety requirements 
 Typical Project Environment The role may involve managing projects across: Airport Terminal Systems | Baggage Handling Systems | Baggage Screening | Automation & Controls | Airport IT/OT | Security Systems | System Integration | Testing & Commissioning | Airport Infrastructure Experience Level 10–18+ years overall experience

The role involves handling complex and critical incidents, outages, performing in-depth root cause analysis, and leading SAP upgrades, migrations, and technical improvements . The consultant will act as a technical subject matter expert for SAP landscape management and work closely with business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, and infrastructure teams to ensure high availability, reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of SAP systems. Should be customer-focused , with a strong commitment to system stability, availability, performance, and timely resolution of critical issues. Upgrades and Migrations: Plan and execute SAP system upgrades, enhancement pack installations, and database migrations. Ensure system integrity and data consistency during migrations. System Monitoring: Implement and maintain monitoring tools, analyse logs, and proactively identify potential issues to ensure optimal system performance and availability. Security Administration: Oversee SAP user and role administration, system security, and compliance with audit requirements. Manage authorisations and implement security patches. Hands-on experience with SAP kernel upgrades, support package upgrades, system refreshes, and technical maintenance activities . Strong understanding of SAP transport management, user administration, system copies, and configuration management . RISE with SAP / Cloud Expertise Strong practical experience working within the RISE with SAP / Managed Service (MSM) delivery model . Good understanding of SAP RISE operational processes, responsibilities, service management, and coordination with SAP/infrastructure teams. Hands-on experience with SAP monitoring and management tools , such as SAP Focused Run (FRUN), Solution Manager , and relevant monitoring platforms. Good understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts , preferably in AWS, Azure, or GCP , in the context of SAP RISE. Experience with automation and runbook execution , including scripting and automation of routine BASIS activities. Strong understanding of SAP security, certificates/PSE, connectivity, compliance, and operational security practices .

title: Programme Manager - Transformation
description:
Job Summary 
 As Programme Manager (Transformation) you will lead the HR PMO, ensuring People transformation and CI initiatives are prioritised, governed and delivered effectively across the employee lifecycle. You will partner closely with People Solutions, Digital Technology and HR leaders to translate strategy into executable plans - providing the governance, delivery discipline and insight required to successfully deliver transformation programmes. Through a people experience lens, you will ensure solutions improve how employees interact with People Solutions; creating simpler, more intuitive and more effective experiences from hire to retire. Success in this role will be measured not only by delivery performance, but by the employee and business outcomes achieved through the project portfolio. 

 About the team 
 People Solutions Excellence exists to drive executional excellence in HR operations, services and transactions. We help improve how People Solutions operates by making processes simpler, services better, decisions more data-driven, and change more successful. Were a global team of experts in process improvement, people experience, service excellence, data and analytics, reporting, and project delivery. Working closely with our HR Centres of Excellence and People Solutions teams, we solve problems, streamline ways of working, and drive continuous improvement. Our role is to create consistent, scalable solutions that work globally while allowing for local needs where required. We bridge the gap between business requirements and operational delivery; helping People Solutions deliver better experiences, stronger outcomes, and lasting adoption of change. The HR PMO is a critical capability within this team. It provides the governance, structure and delivery discipline that turns strategic ambition into measurable outcomes. By ensuring initiatives are prioritised, coordinated and executed effectively, the PMO enables sustainable transformation and continuous improvement across the entire employee journey. 

 About the role 

 Key responsibilities 
 Own the HR Transformation PMO framework, establishing consistent governance, reporting, planning and delivery standards across HR CI projects and transformation initiatives. Maintain an integrated portfolio view of priorities, milestones, budgets, resources, dependencies and risks, enabling effective decision making and delivery oversight. Partner with HR leaders to shape transformation roadmaps; translating strategic priorities into executable programmes and projects, including ownership of the PSE team workplan. Drive delivery excellence across HR technology implementations, operating model changes, service improvements, policy harmonisation and organisational transformation initiatives. Champion employee-centric transformation, ensuring initiatives improve employee, manager and HR user experiences across key moments that matter. Manage governance forums, proactively managing and resolving risks, issues, dependencies and decisions. Deliver reporting and insights, providing visibility of progress, value delivery, resource demand and programme health. Support benefits realisation by ensuring initiatives are linked to measurable business and employee outcomes. Partner with Finance and programme leaders to manage budgets, forecasts, investment decisions and resource planning across the portfolio. Drive continuous improvement of transformation governance, delivery methodologies and PMO practices, leveraging technology, automation and AI where appropriate. Lead and develop HR Project Managers and the wider PMO team; setting clear priorities, performance expectations and development goals. Build capability through consistent standards, disciplined delivery, strong governance and effective stakeholder engagement. Lead standalone HR projects and workstreams, delivering agreed outcomes to scope, time, cost and quality. 

 About you 
 Technical and functional expertise: 8-10 years experience in programme management, PMO, transformation, operational excellence or related disciplines. Proven experience leading complex global transformation programmes and portfolios. Formal certification in project management methodologies (e.g. PMP, APM, PRINCE2, Agile) is highly advantageous. Strong expertise in programme governance, portfolio management, resource planning, budgeting and benefits realisation. Experience delivering HR transformation, HR technology or business transformation initiatives in complex global organisations. Strong understanding of employee lifecycle processes, HR operating models and shared services environments. Experience working with enterprise HR technologies such as Workday, ServiceNow or similar platforms. Demonstrable experience using data and insights to drive decision-making and delivery performance. Knowledge of automation, AI and digital transformation practices is advantageous. 

 Leadership and behavioural capabilities 
 Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. Strong communication and influencing capabilities across global and cross-functional environments. Ability to influence without direct authority and align multiple stakeholders around shared outcomes. Strong commercial thinking, analytical capability and problem-solving skills. Demonstrable capability to lead change, drive adoption and deliver sustainable business outcomes in complex environments. Previous experience of managing team is highly advantageous.

The role involves planning, coordination, execution, quality assurance, safety compliance, subcontractor management, and timely delivery of faade and associated works in line with project schedules, quality standards, and client requirements. The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on experience in faade construction, curtain wall systems, glazing, aluminium works, faade installation methodologies, and subcontractor management within major construction projects. Key Responsibilities Project Execution & Planning Organize and manage all resources, manpower, materials, and field activities related to faade works. Ensure efficient and economical execution of faade packages within approved cost, quality, and timeline targets. Monitor project progress and ensure adherence to planned schedules and milestones. Coordinate with construction teams and internal departments for smooth project execution. Technical Management Review and implement approved faade drawings, shop drawings, and construction methodologies. Ensure approved Method Statements, Risk Assessments, and construction procedures are implemented at site. Resolve technical and construction-related issues in coordination with Project Management and Design teams. Coordinate with consultants, architects, and clients on faade-related approvals and technical clarifications. Quality Management Ensure implementation of Project Quality Plans (PQP) and quality control procedures. Verify that only approved materials are used for faade installation works. Monitor workmanship quality and adherence to project specifications. Drive closure of NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) and implement corrective and preventive actions. Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with HSE requirements, safety policies, and site regulations. Promote a strong safety culture across faade teams and subcontractors. Ensure all faade activities are executed in accordance with statutory and project safety standards. Stakeholder & Subcontractor Management Coordinate and manage faade subcontractors on site. Conduct progress review meetings with subcontractors and internal teams. Liaise with client representatives, consultants, and package managers on day-to-day construction activities. Monitor subcontractor performance, productivity, and quality compliance. Documentation & Handover Ensure timely submission of inspections, quality records, and progress reports. Coordinate preparation and submission of as-built drawings. Support project close-out activities and final handover documentation. Educational Qualification Full-Time Engineering Graduate or Diploma in: Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Structural Engineering Experience 7 to 12 years of experience in construction project execution. Strong experience in: High-Rise Residential Buildings Commercial Towers Mixed-Use Developments Institutional Buildings Large Building Construction Projects Proven experience in faade systems including: Curtain Wall Systems Unitized Faade Systems Stick Glazing Systems ACP Cladding Glass Faades Aluminium Faade Works Skylights and Architectural Metal Works Mandatory Requirement Candidates must be currently working with Building Construction / EPC Contractors executing projects at site . Experience from PMC (Project Management Consultancy), Design Consultancy, Architectural Consultancy, or Pure Design Organizations will not be considered . Preference will be given to candidates with hands-on site execution responsibility for faade packages in large construction projects. title: Senior Technical Delivery Manager (TDM)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE Rafay is seeking a hands-on Senior Technical Program Management to lead strategic customer deployments and drive execution across Rafay s Kubernetes and GPU PaaS platform initiatives. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for overseeing complex enterprise implementations while remaining deeply engaged in technical delivery, customer architecture discussions, and cross-functional execution. 
 The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership with deep technical expertise in Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, GPU/AI workloads, and enterprise platform delivery. This leader will serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders, helping drive successful onboarding, modernization, migration, and adoption initiatives across large-scale enterprise environments. Unlike a traditional people-management-only director role, this position requires hands-on involvement in technical project execution, customer solutioning, escalation management, and operational leadership. 
 TOP 3 REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE 
 - Proven leadership managing complex enterprise technical programs and customer-facing implementations in cloud, Kubernetes, AI/ML, or infrastructure environments. 
 - Deep technical expertise in Kubernetes, GPU workloads, cloud platforms, containers, and modern infrastructure architectures. 
 - Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence customer leadership, engineering teams, and cross-functional partners. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 - Lead and oversee strategic customer implementations for Rafay s Kubernetes and GPU PaaS platform offerings across EMEA. 
 - Serve as the primary technical program leader for large-scale onboarding, migration, modernization, and platform adoption initiatives. 
 - Drive program execution across multiple concurrent enterprise engagements while maintaining hands-on involvement in technical planning and delivery. 
 - Partner directly with customer engineering, platform, infrastructure, DevOps, and executive stakeholders to define scope, align priorities, and ensure successful outcomes. 
 - Lead customer discovery workshops, architecture reviews, technical planning sessions, and implementation governance. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, and Partner teams to align delivery priorities and remove execution blockers. 
 - Provide technical leadership and guidance around Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, cloud-native architectures, AI/ML platform deployments, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud implementations. 
 - Establish scalable delivery processes, implementation methodologies, operational best practices, and program governance frameworks. 
 - Own program risk management, escalation handling, dependency tracking, and executive-level communication throughout the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Drive accountability across internal and external teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with customer expectations. 
 - Act as a senior escalation point for complex customer issues, deployment challenges, and critical implementation risks. 
 - Mentor and guide TPMs, solutions architects, and technical delivery resources while helping scale Rafay s customer delivery organization. 
 - Maintain hands-on familiarity with supporting technologies and frameworks including Observability, DevSecOps, CI/CD, GitOps, FinOps, GPU orchestration, and cloud infrastructure tooling. 
 - Contribute to strategic initiatives that improve customer onboarding, operational efficiency, deployment automation, and overall customer experience. 
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 - Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field. 
 - 10+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise software delivery. 
 - 5+ years leading complex enterprise customer deployments involving Kubernetes, cloud-native technologies, infrastructure modernization, or AI/ML platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on technical expertise with Kubernetes, containers, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, infrastructure, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional technical teams in fast-paced startup or high-growth technology environments. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud operations, infrastructure scalability, and modernization initiatives. 
 - Proven ability to communicate effectively with executives, architects, engineers, and customer stakeholders. 
 - Experience managing multiple concurrent programs with complex dependencies and executive visibility. 
 - Preferred certifications include PMP, AWS Solutions Architect, CKA/CKAD, or equivalent cloud/Kubernetes certifications.

title: Jr Regulatory Project Mgr - Labelling Comp & Business Performance
description:
Job Summary 
 This role will work across Business Performance and Compliance within GSK Labelling to ensure labelling activities are monitored and managed in compliance with GSK policies and procedures, to leverage existing resources and sources of data to provide metrics for the efficient operational management of the GSK Labelling functions and lead system and data administrative support for users of labelling systems. This role will design and manage data visualisation dashboards from regulatory tracking systems and databases in accordance with defined standards and processes to provide insights and analytics to stakeholders. This role is suitable for candidates who wish to develop skills in technology, systems, and digital data analytics supporting the GSK Labelling teams along with aligning to internal/external partners. This role is a business partner to the functional head, with responsibilities of developing, reporting, analysing, and presenting metrics across multiple business functions within Global Regulatory Affairs. This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: Manage collection and analysis of performance compliance data, report dissemination and follow-up for flagged events for labelling activities within an agreed schedule across global, regional, and local levels. Support activities for the development, implementation, maintenance, and use of standards and processes to maximize quality and efficiency of continuous improvements. Demonstrated project leadership skills managing several projects/activities at various stages of development. Support various labelling systems and processes in accordance with GSK policies and procedures. Leverage modern data visualization and analytics technologies to create dynamic business dashboards to effectively communicate and bring key insights to life for the business to improve visibility of key performance indicators (KPIs), resource tracking, compliance monitoring, and forecasting. Proactively work with business services to identify areas for improvements to create efficiencies in labelling processes and use data analytics to propose solutions for effective decision making. Accountable for the development, communication, and training of systems and tools within GSK Labelling including delivery of high-quality analyses and metrics. Produce and communicate service metrics and compile into monthly reports for distribution and escalation along with identifying trends, patterns and improvements using data. Define automation and simplification initiatives with support from business partners to reduce manual/redundant processes, eliminate risks and drive continuous improvement. Understanding of system testing tools and procedures to work with Tech and Business System Owners on solution delivery and support, such as defining scripts for user acceptance testing (UAT), migration and training. 
 
 Working arrangement 
 This role is hybrid. You will work regularly from the GSK office in Poland and collaborate with international colleagues. Exact hybrid pattern will be agreed with your manager. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in business administration or life sciences field or related field appropriate to the function. Relevant experience (in pharmaceutical industry, life sciences research or regulatory operations, compliance, or labelling) delivering business operational support to critical business systems in a global environment. Successfully performed in a regulated or quality-critical environment such as pharmaceutical industry research or regulatory. Consistent and accurate completion of data reporting, analysis, and follow-up tasks. Ability to use adequate tools and systems to collate and report on appropriate performance measures for the business. High attention to detail, significant experience with document and database management, excellent organization and time management skills, and a commitment to quality. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to present information in a clear and concise manner with the ability to interact with various levels of management. Ability to think flexibly to meet shifting priorities and timelines. Good project management and facilitation abilities/experience. Data visualization and data mining experience. 
 
 What we offer 
 Established job in an international, well-known pharmaceutical company. Opportunity to work in a professional team playing a crucial role in maintaining GSK portfolio on the markets. Opportunity to work within GSK standards and documentation applied globally. Wide range of benefits (Medical Plan, Life Insurance, Employee Retirement Program, Sport and recreation cards, Recreation allowance, annual bonus). Supportive friendly working environment. We're looking for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment, is passionate about delivering results, and is eager to make a difference. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! #LI-GSK #Li-hybrid

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Job Title Senior Project Manager Job Description Summary We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side.
 
The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead, providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction.
 
The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets.
 
The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements.
 
The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client. Job Description 1. Position Overview We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side. The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead , providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction . The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets. The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements . The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . 2. Primary Role Client Representative The PMC Project Manager shall function as the single-point project delivery lead for the PMC , representing the Client''s interests at site. Key responsibilities include: Provide overall leadership to the PMC project team. Act as the primary interface between the Client, PMC, consultants and contractors. Establish project management and governance systems. Ensure that project objectives are clearly communicated to all stakeholders. Monitor and control contractor performance against contractual obligations. Identify project risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Provide independent advice to the Client on project progress, risks, costs, delays and contractual matters. Ensure that all major project decisions are supported by appropriate technical, commercial and schedule analysis. Maintain complete transparency in reporting project status to the Client. Ensure that the Client''s interests are protected throughout the project lifecycle. 3. Project Planning & Schedule Management The Project Manager shall provide overall leadership for project planning and programme control. Responsibilities include: Review and approve the overall Project Master Programme prepared by the Planning team. Review contractor baseline programmes and detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules. Ensure alignment between design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning schedules. Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline. Identify critical path and near-critical activities. Monitor achievement of contractual and project milestones. Review contractor look-ahead programmes and recovery schedules. Challenge unrealistic contractor programmes and claimed progress. Review the impact of design changes, approvals, procurement and site constraints on the programme. Ensure timely implementation of recovery and mitigation measures. Review and advise the Client on potential Extension of Time claims. Coordinate delay analysis and schedule impact assessments. Ensure that project completion forecasts are realistic and evidence-based. 4. Construction Management Provide overall supervision and management of construction activities through the PMC team. Ensure that contractors execute works in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements and contracts. Monitor construction methodology and sequencing. Ensure adequate deployment of manpower, plant, equipment and materials. Monitor productivity and identify underperformance. Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, faade, interiors, landscape and external development works. Manage interfaces between various contractors and packages. Identify construction constraints and coordinate timely resolution. Ensure that site activities are properly coordinated to avoid rework and disruption. Monitor construction quality and progress through regular site inspections and reviews. Ensure timely escalation of critical issues to the Client. 5. Contractor Management A key responsibility of the PMC Project Manager will be to manage and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . The candidate shall: Review contractor mobilisation and resource deployment. Monitor manpower, plant, equipment and material availability. Assess contractor productivity and performance. Conduct regular contractor performance reviews. Establish clear performance expectations and corrective actions. Issue/coordinate appropriate contractual communications through the PMC. Challenge contractor delays, inadequate resources and poor productivity. Review contractor recovery plans. Monitor compliance with contractual milestones. Recommend appropriate contractual remedies in case of persistent underperformance. Ensure that contractor commitments made during progress meetings are tracked and closed. Maintain proper records of contractor performance, delays and non-compliances. 6. Contract Administration & Claims Management The Project Manager shall provide strong oversight of contract administration and claims. Responsibilities include: Review construction contracts and understand key commercial and contractual obligations. Ensure that PMC teams monitor contractor compliance with contractual requirements. Review contractor notices, claims, variations and EOT submissions. Coordinate with the QS/Commercial Manager for evaluation of variations and claims. Ensure timely assessment of additional cost and time implications. Review contractual entitlement and supporting documentation. Ensure proper recording of delay events and Client/contractor responsibilities. Coordinate preparation of recommendations to the Client. Protect the Client from unjustified claims and cost escalation. Ensure that contractual correspondence is properly documented. Assist in dispute avoidance and resolution. Working knowledge of FIDIC, EPC, Design & Build and Item Rate contracts is preferred. 7. Cost Management The PMC Project Manager shall provide overall oversight of project cost control. Responsibilities include: Monitor project cost against the approved budget. Review cost reports prepared by the commercial/QS team. Monitor committed, certified, actual and forecast expenditure. Review variations and change orders. Assess cost impact of design changes and Client instructions. Monitor potential cost overruns. Review contractor claims and commercial submissions. Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained for variations. Monitor project contingency and risk allowances. Provide the Client with an independent assessment of the forecast final cost. Ensure cost and programme implications are considered before recommending major changes. 8. Design Management Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants and specialist consultants. Monitor design deliverables against the construction programme. Ensure timely release of Good for Construction drawings. Identify design gaps and interface issues. Ensure timely closure of RFIs and technical queries. Coordinate design reviews and constructability reviews. Monitor design changes and assess their impact on cost and programme. Coordinate BIM/clash detection processes where applicable. Ensure that construction does not proceed based on incomplete or unapproved information. Maintain a design deliverables and approval tracker. 9. Procurement Management Review and monitor the project procurement strategy. Ensure procurement schedules are aligned with the master programme. Monitor long-lead items and critical equipment. Review vendor approval and material submittal processes. Monitor procurement risks and potential delays. Ensure timely release of purchase orders and subcontract packages. Coordinate procurement with design and construction requirements. Escalate procurement issues that could affect project milestones. Monitor delivery of critical materials and equipment to site. 10. Quality Management The PMC Project Manager shall ensure that the Client''s quality objectives are achieved. Responsibilities include: Implement and monitor the Project Quality Management Plan. Review contractor quality plans and inspection procedures. Monitor compliance with project specifications and approved materials. Ensure inspection and testing procedures are followed. Review quality audits and inspection reports. Monitor NCRs, observations and corrective actions. Identify recurring quality issues and implement preventive measures. Ensure appropriate mock-ups and benchmark samples are approved. Monitor workmanship and finishing standards. Ensure quality documentation is complete for project handover. 11. Health, Safety & Environment Provide leadership to ensure a strong project safety culture. Monitor contractor compliance with HSE requirements. Review contractor HSE plans and performance. Ensure regular safety audits and inspections. Monitor high-risk construction activities. Ensure timely closure of safety observations. Escalate serious safety violations to the Client. Promote a zero-incident / zero-tolerance approach to unsafe practices . Ensure environmental and statutory requirements are complied with. 12. Risk Management The Project Manager shall lead the PMC''s project risk-management process. Responsibilities include: Establish and maintain the Project Risk Register. Identify risks related to: Programme Cost Design Procurement Contractor performance Quality Safety Statutory approvals Contracts and claims Stakeholder interfaces Assess probability and potential impact. Develop mitigation and contingency measures. Monitor implementation of risk mitigation actions. Escalate high-impact risks to the Client. Ensure emerging risks are identified before they become project issues. 13. Project Controls & MIS Ensure that the PMC project controls system provides the Client with an accurate and timely view of project performance. The Project Manager shall review: Master schedule Monthly progress S-curves Critical path Milestone tracking Contractor performance Cost reports Variation/change register Procurement tracker Design tracker Material approval tracker Risk register Issue register NCR/quality tracker HSE performance Manpower and productivity Claims/EOT register Forecast completion dates Forecast final cost The candidate should be capable of interpreting project data and converting it into actionable recommendations , rather than merely reviewing reports. 14. Client Reporting & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary PMC interface with the Client. Conduct weekly and monthly project review meetings. Prepare management-level project reports. Present project status, key risks, delays and commercial issues to senior Client management. Provide clear recommendations and alternative solutions. Ensure timely escalation of critical decisions. Manage expectations of Client, consultants and contractors. Maintain transparent and professional communication with all stakeholders. Ensure that decisions and commitments are properly recorded and followed through. 15. Testing, Commissioning & Handover Develop and monitor the overall testing and commissioning strategy. Coordinate commissioning of MEP and specialist systems. Monitor statutory inspections and approvals. Coordinate snagging and de-snagging activities. Monitor completion of all works against the approved scope. Ensure as-built drawings and O&M manuals are completed. Ensure warranties, test certificates and statutory documentation are compiled. Coordinate final handover to the Client. Ensure smooth transition from construction to operations. 16. PMC Team Leadership The Project Manager will lead and coordinate the PMC team, which may include: Planning Engineer Civil/Structural Engineers Architectural/Finishes Engineers MEP Engineers QA/QC Engineers Safety Engineers QS/Commercial Manager Contracts/Claims personnel Procurement specialists Document Controllers Other specialist consultants Responsibilities include: Define roles and responsibilities. Establish reporting structures. Monitor individual and team performance. Ensure adequate staffing against project requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary activities. Ensure timely reporting and escalation. Build a strong, collaborative PMC team culture. 17. Authority & Decision-Making The candidate should have the maturity to distinguish between matters that can be resolved at project level and those requiring Client approval. The Project Manager shall: Provide technical and commercial recommendations to the Client. Recommend acceptance/rejection of contractor submissions. Recommend corrective measures for contractor underperformance. Recommend recovery strategies. Recommend variations and change orders based on technical/commercial evaluation. Recommend contractual action where justified. Escalate matters requiring Client approval with clear options and implications. The role is primarily one of independent review, management and recommendation on behalf of the Client, rather than routine contractor supervision. 18. description:
Job Title Project Manager Job Description Summary We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side.
 
The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead, providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction.
 
The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets.
 
The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements.
 
The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client. Job Description The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead , providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction . The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets. The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements . The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . 2. Primary Role Client Representative The PMC Project Manager shall function as the single-point project delivery lead for the PMC , representing the Client''s interests at site. Key responsibilities include: Provide overall leadership to the PMC project team. Act as the primary interface between the Client, PMC, consultants and contractors. Establish project management and governance systems. Ensure that project objectives are clearly communicated to all stakeholders. Monitor and control contractor performance against contractual obligations. Identify project risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Provide independent advice to the Client on project progress, risks, costs, delays and contractual matters. Ensure that all major project decisions are supported by appropriate technical, commercial and schedule analysis. Maintain complete transparency in reporting project status to the Client. Ensure that the Client''s interests are protected throughout the project lifecycle. 3. Project Planning & Schedule Management The Project Manager shall provide overall leadership for project planning and programme control. Responsibilities include: Review and approve the overall Project Master Programme prepared by the Planning team. Review contractor baseline programmes and detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules. Ensure alignment between design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning schedules. Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline. Identify critical path and near-critical activities. Monitor achievement of contractual and project milestones. Review contractor look-ahead programmes and recovery schedules. Challenge unrealistic contractor programmes and claimed progress. Review the impact of design changes, approvals, procurement and site constraints on the programme. Ensure timely implementation of recovery and mitigation measures. Review and advise the Client on potential Extension of Time claims. Coordinate delay analysis and schedule impact assessments. Ensure that project completion forecasts are realistic and evidence-based. 4. Construction Management Provide overall supervision and management of construction activities through the PMC team. Ensure that contractors execute works in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements and contracts. Monitor construction methodology and sequencing. Ensure adequate deployment of manpower, plant, equipment and materials. Monitor productivity and identify underperformance. Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, faade, interiors, landscape and external development works. Manage interfaces between various contractors and packages. Identify construction constraints and coordinate timely resolution. Ensure that site activities are properly coordinated to avoid rework and disruption. Monitor construction quality and progress through regular site inspections and reviews. Ensure timely escalation of critical issues to the Client. 5. Contractor Management A key responsibility of the PMC Project Manager will be to manage and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . The candidate shall: Review contractor mobilisation and resource deployment. Monitor manpower, plant, equipment and material availability. Assess contractor productivity and performance. Conduct regular contractor performance reviews. Establish clear performance expectations and corrective actions. Issue/coordinate appropriate contractual communications through the PMC. Challenge contractor delays, inadequate resources and poor productivity. Review contractor recovery plans. Monitor compliance with contractual milestones. Recommend appropriate contractual remedies in case of persistent underperformance. Ensure that contractor commitments made during progress meetings are tracked and closed. Maintain proper records of contractor performance, delays and non-compliances. 6. Contract Administration & Claims Management The Project Manager shall provide strong oversight of contract administration and claims. Responsibilities include: Review construction contracts and understand key commercial and contractual obligations. Ensure that PMC teams monitor contractor compliance with contractual requirements. Review contractor notices, claims, variations and EOT submissions. Coordinate with the QS/Commercial Manager for evaluation of variations and claims. Ensure timely assessment of additional cost and time implications. Review contractual entitlement and supporting documentation. Ensure proper recording of delay events and Client/contractor responsibilities. Coordinate preparation of recommendations to the Client. Protect the Client from unjustified claims and cost escalation. Ensure that contractual correspondence is properly documented. Assist in dispute avoidance and resolution. Working knowledge of FIDIC, EPC, Design & Build and Item Rate contracts is preferred. 7. Cost Management The PMC Project Manager shall provide overall oversight of project cost control. Responsibilities include: Monitor project cost against the approved budget. Review cost reports prepared by the commercial/QS team. Monitor committed, certified, actual and forecast expenditure. Review variations and change orders. Assess cost impact of design changes and Client instructions. Monitor potential cost overruns. Review contractor claims and commercial submissions. Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained for variations. Monitor project contingency and risk allowances. Provide the Client with an independent assessment of the forecast final cost. Ensure cost and programme implications are considered before recommending major changes. 8. Design Management Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants and specialist consultants. Monitor design deliverables against the construction programme. Ensure timely release of Good for Construction drawings. Identify design gaps and interface issues. Ensure timely closure of RFIs and technical queries. Coordinate design reviews and constructability reviews. Monitor design changes and assess their impact on cost and programme. Coordinate BIM/clash detection processes where applicable. Ensure that construction does not proceed based on incomplete or unapproved information. Maintain a design deliverables and approval tracker. 9. Procurement Management Review and monitor the project procurement strategy. Ensure procurement schedules are aligned with the master programme. Monitor long-lead items and critical equipment. Review vendor approval and material submittal processes. Monitor procurement risks and potential delays. Ensure timely release of purchase orders and subcontract packages. Coordinate procurement with design and construction requirements. Escalate procurement issues that could affect project milestones. Monitor delivery of critical materials and equipment to site. 10. Quality Management The PMC Project Manager shall ensure that the Client''s quality objectives are achieved. Responsibilities include: Implement and monitor the Project Quality Management Plan. Review contractor quality plans and inspection procedures. Monitor compliance with project specifications and approved materials. Ensure inspection and testing procedures are followed. Review quality audits and inspection reports. Monitor NCRs, observations and corrective actions. Identify recurring quality issues and implement preventive measures. Ensure appropriate mock-ups and benchmark samples are approved. Monitor workmanship and finishing standards. Ensure quality documentation is complete for project handover. 11. Health, Safety & Environment Provide leadership to ensure a strong project safety culture. Monitor contractor compliance with HSE requirements. Review contractor HSE plans and performance. Ensure regular safety audits and inspections. Monitor high-risk construction activities. Ensure timely closure of safety observations. Escalate serious safety violations to the Client. Promote a zero-incident / zero-tolerance approach to unsafe practices . Ensure environmental and statutory requirements are complied with. 12. Risk Management The Project Manager shall lead the PMC''s project risk-management process. Responsibilities include: Establish and maintain the Project Risk Register. Identify risks related to: Programme Cost Design Procurement Contractor performance Quality Safety Statutory approvals Contracts and claims Stakeholder interfaces Assess probability and potential impact. Develop mitigation and contingency measures. Monitor implementation of risk mitigation actions. Escalate high-impact risks to the Client. Ensure emerging risks are identified before they become project issues. 13. Project Controls & MIS Ensure that the PMC project controls system provides the Client with an accurate and timely view of project performance. The Project Manager shall review: Master schedule Monthly progress S-curves Critical path Milestone tracking Contractor performance Cost reports Variation/change register Procurement tracker Design tracker Material approval tracker Risk register Issue register NCR/quality tracker HSE performance Manpower and productivity Claims/EOT register Forecast completion dates Forecast final cost The candidate should be capable of interpreting project data and converting it into actionable recommendations , rather than merely reviewing reports. 14. Client Reporting & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary PMC interface with the Client. Conduct weekly and monthly project review meetings. Prepare management-level project reports. Present project status, key risks, delays and commercial issues to senior Client management. Provide clear recommendations and alternative solutions. Ensure timely escalation of critical decisions. Manage expectations of Client, consultants and contractors. Maintain transparent and professional communication with all stakeholders. Ensure that decisions and commitments are properly recorded and followed through. 15. Testing, Commissioning & Handover Develop and monitor the overall testing and commissioning strategy. Coordinate commissioning of MEP and specialist systems. Monitor statutory inspections and approvals. Coordinate snagging and de-snagging activities. Monitor completion of all works against the approved scope. Ensure as-built drawings and O&M manuals are completed. Ensure warranties, test certificates and statutory documentation are compiled. Coordinate final handover to the Client. Ensure smooth transition from construction to operations. 16. PMC Team Leadership The Project Manager will lead and coordinate the PMC team, which may include: Planning Engineer Civil/Structural Engineers Architectural/Finishes Engineers MEP Engineers QA/QC Engineers Safety Engineers QS/Commercial Manager Contracts/Claims personnel Procurement specialists Document Controllers Other specialist consultants Responsibilities include: Define roles and responsibilities. Establish reporting structures. Monitor individual and team performance. Ensure adequate staffing against project requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary activities. Ensure timely reporting and escalation. Build a strong, collaborative PMC team culture. 17. Authority & Decision-Making The candidate should have the maturity to distinguish between matters that can be resolved at project level and those requiring Client approval. The Project Manager shall: Provide technical and commercial recommendations to the Client. Recommend acceptance/rejection of contractor submissions. Recommend corrective measures for contractor underperformance. Recommend recovery strategies. Recommend variations and change orders based on technical/commercial evaluation. Recommend contractual action where justified. Escalate matters requiring Client approval with clear options and implications. The role is primarily one of independent review, management and recommendation on behalf of the Client, rather than routine contractor supervision. 18. description:
Job Summary As an Associate Technical Project Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of customer projects across cloud migration, modernization, infrastructure, and AI engagements. You will work alongside Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineers to translate an approved solution into a planned, tracked, and governed delivery - and you will be the primary point of contact the customer relies on for progress, risks, and decisions. This role sits at the intersection of technology and delivery governance. You are expected to understand the technical solution well enough to challenge estimates, spot dependencies early, and hold both the team and the customer to agreed scope, effort, and timelines. Key Responsibilities Project Planning Review project proposals to ensure in-scope and out-of-scope items, effort and cost estimation, deliverables, assumptions, and the proposed architecture are clearly defined. Analyze project requirements and prepare or update project timelines, delivery methodology, RACI, milestones, and deliverables. Ensure use cases and test cases are clearly defined before the project is onboarded to the delivery team. Prepare the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) before implementation and review it with the Technical Lead. Establish timelines and milestones and plan delivery within the approved budget. Technical Project Management Develop a sound understanding of the technical deliverables and work closely with Architects and Technical Leads to identify and manage risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans. Regularly review the technical solution and implementation progress with the Technical Lead to ensure planned activities are completed within the agreed timeline. Track project scope, schedule, effort, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and as per agreed scope. Assess project risks, develop risk mitigation strategies, and implement contingency plans to minimize the impact of potential issues. Identify project blockers and follow the defined escalation hierarchy for timely resolution. Delivery Across Project Types Migration and cloud projects: Manage end-to-end delivery of cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure projects, tracking cloud-specific activities, technical dependencies, risks, and milestones with Architects and Technical Leads. Non-migration technical projects: Manage end-to-end delivery of AI PoC implementations, AI assessments, and similar engagements, ensuring requirements, use cases, test cases, technical deliverables, and timelines are clearly defined and aligned with the approved solution. Coordinate with the technical teams responsible for moving applications between Development, Test, Integration, and Production environments. Manage change requests across cloud migration activities and track all associated events to maximize system availability and avoid errors. Customer & Stakeholder Management Coordinate and conduct regular daily stand-ups and customer meetings, and maintain meeting minutes, action items, expectations, and discussion points. Prepare and share weekly project status reports covering progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and next steps. Maintain effective communication and coordination between customers, Sales, Architects, Technical Leads, Engineers, and other stakeholders. Keep clients, executives, and external partners engaged throughout the project lifecycle to sustain involvement and satisfaction.

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Layout Design
description:
We are seeking a Senior Staff Layout Design Engineer with deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal layout for power and analog IC products. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong technical ownership, independent judgment, and the ability to lead layout execution for complex blocks and full-chip designs. The successful candidate will translate circuit requirements into robust, manufacturable layouts for products such as PMICs, linear and switching regulators, gate drivers, battery-management ICs, and other power and analog devices. The role requires close collaboration with analog designers, CAD, process, package, reliability, and verification teams. You will be expected to own challenging layout problems, establish best practices, improve methodology and automation, mentor engineers, and drive projects from floor planning through physical verification and tape-out readiness. Responsibilities Layout Architecture & Execution Own floor planning and physical implementation for complex analog, power, and mixed-signal blocks, and contribute to full-chip layout planning. Collaborate with circuit designers to capture electrical, matching, isolation, current-density, thermal, reliability, and area requirements. Apply advanced layout techniques for device matching, parasitic reduction, noise isolation, high-current routing, electromigration robustness, thermal behavior, and yield optimization. Drive routing, integration, and sign-off readiness for block-level and chip-level layouts. Physical Verification & Sign-off Own and review DRC, LVS, ERC, PEX, antenna, density, latch-up, and reliability verification as required by the process and product. Analyse extracted parasitics with designers and support post-layout simulation closure. Identify physical-design risks early and drive corrective actions with design, CAD, PDK, process, and package teams. Ensure layout databases, review records, and release documentation meet tape-out quality standards. Methodology, Automation & IP Reuse Develop and deploy automation using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar languages to improve quality and turnaround time. Drive layout methodology improvements, reusable templates, checklists, and portability of IP across products and process technologies. Work with corporate engineering and CAD teams to resolve tool, PDK, extraction, and process-flow issues. Evaluate new layout tools and techniques and lead practical adoption within the team. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Lead layout reviews and provide clear estimates, progress updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans. Mentor junior and mid-level layout engineers and raise the technical standard of the broader team. Influence project planning, task allocation, technical decisions, and hiring through demonstrated technical depth. Operate independently on ambiguous and complex assignments, escalating issues with clear options and recommendations. Qualifications Bachelor or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in analog, power, or mixed-signal IC layout and associated development flows. Demonstrated ownership of complex block-level layout and meaningful contribution to full-chip integration and tape-out. Deep understanding of matching, parasitic control, noise isolation, guard rings, latch-up prevention, high-current routing, electromigration, IR drop, thermal effects, and reliability-aware layout. Hands-on expertise with Cadence Virtuoso and physical verification tools such as Calibre, PVS, or equivalent. Experience with extraction and reliability tools is expected. Experience working with deep-submicron CMOS and preferably BCD or high-voltage process technologies. Ability to automate layout or verification tasks using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar scripting languages. Proven ability to lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and drive layout methodology improvements. Strong cross-functional communication skills in a multisite and multicultural environment. Results-oriented, self-driven, and able to deliver high-quality work under tight schedules with limited supervision.

title: Sr. Staff Engineer PD
description:
Job Summary The Physical Design Engineer delivers hands-on expertise in designing and implementing custom silicon solutions to meet detailed customer requirements. This role executes physical design flows-including synthesis, place-and-route, and verification-while applying standardized methodologies for efficient IP reuse, rapid turnaround, and high-quality tape-outs. Responsibilities Implement DFT architectures including ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, scan insertion, and analog test features Execute all phases of physical design: synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, place-and-route, timing closure, power/noise analysis, and signoff verification. Implement design strategies to achieve performance, area, and power targets for customer-specific ICs under lead guidance. Apply re-use methodologies, leveraging standard IP blocks, libraries, and flows to accelerate project execution. Resolve timing, congestion, and power issues in high-speed, high-density designs using EDA tools and scripting. Collaborate with RTL design, verification, DFT, and package teams to integrate requirements and ensure design convergence. Perform physical verification (DRC, LVS) and support debug for clean tape-out deliverables. Automate flows with TCL, Python, or Perl scripts to improve productivity and repeatability. Analyze design metrics and contribute to process improvements through data-driven insights. Other Responsibilities Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety Security requirements and programs. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 4+ years of hands-on physical design experience on SoCs, covering RTL-to-GDSII flows. Proficiency with EDA tools like Synopsys ICC2/Fusion Compiler, Cadence Innovus/Genus, or Mentor Calibre for synthesis, PNR, STA, and verification. Strong knowledge of STA (PrimeTime/Tempus), power analysis, and congestion mitigation techniques. Experience with scripting (TCL, Python, Perl) for flow automation and debugging. Familiarity with advanced nodes, multi-corner multi-mode (MCMM) analysis, and IP integration. Analytical mindset for tackling complex timing/power challenges and effective cross-team communication. Preferred Qualifications Experience with custom silicon for automotive, high-performance computing, or AI applications. Proactive in adopting new tools, flows, and best practices for re-use and efficiency. Detail-oriented team player committed to quality and on-time delivery.
